summary: Frontend-only testing of Tirelire USDT piggy bank Expo app at mobile viewport 390x844. Verified onboarding (Welcome -> Create -> Verify quiz -> PIN -> Setup -> Activate), Import flow, Demo mode (dashboard, action sheets, plus menu, tabs home/history/team, sub-accounts), language switch EN/FR/AR with RTL layout flip, and no 'Invalid style property direction' crash. Found 2 real bugs: (A) PIN lock bypass on reload for any non-root route (critical security issue), (B) 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React render loop triggered during demo-mode drawer/language interactions (ErrorBoundary catches it, user can be left on a crashed screen). Also an intermittent 'drawer requires 2 clicks' issue likely caused by the same render loop. All testIDs listed in the request were found and clickable when drawer did open.

ui_bugs.issue: PIN lock does not protect non-root routes. After creating a wallet, directly navigating to or reloading /activate, /(tabs), /subaccounts, /setup, etc. renders the screen without ever requiring the user to enter their PIN. Only visiting '/' (splash) routes to /pin?mode=unlock. A global route guard that redirects to /pin?mode=unlock whenever status==='locked' is missing.

In demo mode, opening the drawer and interacting with it (switching language, clicking lang-ar, or exit-demo) sometimes triggers a React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error that the ErrorBoundary catches. Repro: enter demo -> open plus menu -> open deposit sheet -> close -> open drawer -> switch to AR -> exit demo. Error logged: 'Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component repeatedly calls setState inside componentWillUpdate or componentDidUpdate.' Likely a useEffect dependency loop in Drawer or app/_layout Shell triggered by isRTL change.

The drawer intermittently fails to open on the first tap of profile-avatar-button right after a previous overlay was dismissed. A second tap opens it reliably. Suspected toggle-state desync between OverlayHost backdrop press and the open callback.

integration_issues.issue: Expected: reload page -> pin-screen-unlock. Observed: reload stays on current deep-link route (/activate, /(tabs), etc.) with no PIN prompt. Only reaching '/' triggers the splash's locked->pin redirect in app/index.tsx line 41.

action_items: Add a global route guard in app/_layout.tsx (Shell) that watches `status` from useApp() and router.replace('/pin?mode=unlock') whenever status==='locked' and the current route is not /pin. Mirror the splash logic so deep-link reloads cannot bypass PIN.

Diagnose 'Maximum update depth exceeded' in demo-mode drawer. Likely candidates: a useEffect in app/_layout.tsx Shell depending on isRTL that calls setLang/setStatus; or Drawer's language setter triggering parent re-render that re-mounts Drawer. Audit useApp()/useI18n() consumers for setState calls inside render or effects without proper deps.
Fix the two-click drawer open: ensure OverlayHost onClose is not toggling the drawer-open state right after the avatar press. Add a small delay or guard against simultaneous open+close.

Minor: deprecation warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to future-proof against RN upgrades.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx is the only place performing a locked->/pin redirect; this logic should live in a global guard inside Shell so it applies on any deep-link entry.
src/state/app.tsx exposes `lock()` but no `useEffect` in any screen enforces that `status==='locked'` sends the user to /pin. Deep links slip past the splash.
Deposit/transfer/withdraw/plus/drawer sheets use OverlayHost — ensure open/close callbacks are stable (useCallback) to avoid identity-churn re-renders that may feed the setState loop observed.
seed_data_creation: None required (demo mode uses built-in mock data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs documented in the request exist in the code and work when their screen is actually rendered. Key reproducible flows verified: Welcome lang EN/FR/AR, Create (reveal, confirm, quiz w/ 3 positions, pin create + mismatch), Setup (invalid referral disables continue), Activate (price 50, QR, 42-char address, submit disabled), Import (invalid disables continue, 'test test... junk' valid), Demo dashboard $20,790.00, plus menu, tabs. The two bugs to retest after main agent fixes: (1) reload /activate while wallet exists must land on pin-screen-unlock, (2) demo-mode drawer + lang-ar must not throw Max update depth. For (1) a working check is: create wallet, go through to /activate, then page.reload() -> pin-screen-unlock must be visible.
rca_of_issue: Bug A (PIN bypass): app/index.tsx:37-45 effect only runs when the user lands on '/'. Expo Router preserves the current URL on reload, so /activate etc. renders directly without going through index. There is no global `useEffect(()=>{ if(status==='locked' && !atPinRoute) router.replace('/pin?mode=unlock') },[status])` in app/_layout.tsx Shell. Fix: add that effect inside Shell (useSegments to detect current route). Bug B (render loop): error surfaces when switching to AR in the drawer. app/_layout.tsx Shell wraps everything in a View with dirStyle(isRTL?'rtl':'ltr'); switching language updates isRTL in I18nProvider which may re-mount children; combined with a non-memoized callback (open/close) in OverlayHost or Drawer, it can trigger a feedback loop. Confirmed via console error 'Maximum update depth exceeded' and ErrorBoundary catching the crash.
